contentBlocks.text: You've outlined an essay's three parts. Today: words that connect them smoothly!

Formal transition words help an essay flow smoothly between ideas: ਇਸ ਤੋਂ ਇਲਾਵਾ means 'furthermore' or 'in addition,' used to add a new point, and ਅੰਤ ਵਿੱਚ means 'in conclusion' or 'finally,' used to signal the closing ਸਿੱਟਾ. Using yesterday's three-sentence outline, add ਇਸ ਤੋਂ ਇਲਾਵਾ before your ਵਿਸ਼ਾ-ਵਸਤੂ sentence (if you add a second point) and ਅੰਤ ਵਿੱਚ before your ਸਿੱਟਾ sentence, and rewrite the connected version.
You just used real formal transition words! Tomorrow we'll write a complete formal essay.

objectives: Understand ਇਸ ਤੋਂ ਇਲਾਵਾ (furthermore) and ਅੰਤ ਵਿੱਚ (in conclusion)
Correctly add both transition words to yesterday's three-sentence outline
teacherGuide.facilitationScript:
1. Review yesterday's three-part outline briefly.
2. Introduce ਇਸ ਤੋਂ ਇਲਾਵਾ and ਅੰਤ ਵਿੱਚ.
3. Have the child add both transitions to their outline and rewrite it.
4. Complete the worksheet.
5. Preview tomorrow's complete-essay lesson.
differentiationTips: Struggling: model adding just ਅੰਤ ਵਿੱਚ to a simple example sentence first before asking for both transitions
Ready for more: ask the child to think of one more Punjabi transition word they may already know from reading, and how it would be used
These transition words are directly reusable for tomorrow's complete essay, not just an isolated grammar drill
teacherGuide.answerKey: This is an open-ended activity — check that the child correctly places ਇਸ ਤੋਂ ਇਲਾਵਾ before an added point and ਅੰਤ ਵਿੱਚ directly before their ਸਿੱਟਾ sentence.
teacherGuide.standardsRationale: Directly addresses this course's formal-writing thread, teaching transition words that make a formal essay flow, continuing this week's structure lesson.

generationData.instructions: Rewrite your outline using formal transition words.
